offer.say: Okay. Okay okay okay. My bronze test is on Millbrook ice. The evaluator is coming from Duncannon and she has a clipboard, {owner}. A real one. Can the ice be really, really fresh?

options.text: Fresh flood right before. Promise.
Why does it matter so much?
The ice is always fresh. Ish.
I can't promise the schedule that week.

why.say: Because my axel lands on the east circle and if there's a rut there I will die. Not actually die. Test-die. Mom says I'm dramatic. I'm accurate.

options.text: No ruts on the east circle. Deal.
Let me see what I can do.

cheek.say: Ish is not a figure skating word. Ish gets you a retry.

options.text: Fine. Fresh flood, no ish.

decline.say: Oh. Okay. That's okay. I'll just skate around the ruts. Like a hero. A tragic hero.

nerves.say: Thank you! Also, um. How do you not get nervous? Hélène says nerves are 'information'. That's not helpful information.

options.text: Breathe out longer than you breathe in.
Fall well. Knees bent, hands out, then laugh.
Pretend the evaluator is Earl. Nothing impresses him either.

nerves_ok.say: Okay. I'm writing that on my hand.

nerves_earl.say: Oh my gosh. Earl in a blazer with a clipboard. I'm going to laugh during my spiral. That's fine. That's better than crying.

progress.say: Is it fresh? Is it fresh yet? Sorry. Hi.

options.text: Not yet. I'll flood right before.
Fresh. Go get changed.
Just saying hi.

p_test.say: It's so shiny. I can see my face. My face looks scared. Okay. Going.

complete.say: I PASSED. She wrote 'confident edges' on the sheet. Confident! Me! Here, I made you a photocopy. It's for the notice board. Or your fridge. Do rink owners have fridges?

options.text: What got you through it?
It's going on the notice board right now.
I knew you'd do it.

c_why.say: Honestly? The ice. And the thing you said.

options.text: The breathing?
The falling?
Earl?
Mostly you, though.

c_breathe.say: I breathed out for like a whole lap. I think I was the calmest person in the building. Mom was not.

c_fall.say: I fell on my flip in the warm-up and I laughed and then I wasn't scared anymore. Then I landed it in the test. Falling is a cheat code.

c_earl.say: I looked at the evaluator and saw Earl and I couldn't stop smiling. She wrote 'lovely presentation'. Please never tell Earl.

c_board.say: Next to the black cat? Toe Drag is famous. I'm famous now too. Kind of.

c_knew.say: You did not. Nobody did. I didn't. But thank you.

done.say: Senior silver next. Don't worry, I'll tell you about it. A lot.
